title: Common Automation Failures
learning_outcomes: Describe the purpose of Common Automation Failures and define its core vocabulary.
Apply common automation failures in a small PowerShell example and predict its result.
Identify one relevant edge case, version constraint, or troubleshooting step.

content.intro: This lesson covers Common Automation Failures in the PowerShell learning path. It expands the supplied syllabus heading into an actionable draft with a visual, a worked example, and a short knowledge check.
content.why_it_matters: PowerShell can report both non-terminating and terminating errors. Use `-ErrorAction Stop` when a command must enter a `catch` block, log useful diagnostic context without secrets, and use `finally` to release temporary resources consistently.
